statement: One versioned profile/config/report contract is the authoritative identity for P0 and future certified runs, and its deterministic guard accepts complete scale and comparative-consumer fixtures while rejecting incomplete hardware, topology, workload, resource, convergence, provenance, or claim-eligibility evidence.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.
This contract is the sole owner of profile, hardware, topology, workload, resource, convergence, provenance, and claim-eligibility identity; comparative consumers may extend but never fork it.
A valid P0 fixture proves schema and development-profile usability only and must not mark P1, P2, or P3 supported.
